add.title: Card-like layout masters (360 / App bar, 360 / Profile, …) double their padding inside a Card
add.why: They carry their own Scheme fill and padding, so swapped into a Card's Content they read as a same-colour padded box (lint same-on-same). The Showcase instances were given a contrasting Scheme as a stopgap; decide whether content masters drop their fill or get a Card-less variant. Found by lint.js, 2026-11-16.

add.title: Give the Media box in `Card · with media` a taller crop (e.g. 512 × 300), or let instances resize it
add.why: The Media rectangle's size is locked in instances (resize is silently ignored, minHeight refused), so the portrait seagull (480 × 639) only fits whole with a 0.77× vertical squash in every preview (2026-11-17, mastermind-page-1000; doc/pilot-1000.md).

add.title: Rule 2 and lint: a transparent section inside a Page or Card frame is allowed to pad
add.why: Vocabulary v6 (FRAME + SECTIONS) puts the background on the frame, so Header and Body sections pad with no fill of their own. Rule 2 still reads 'padding means its own background', and lint's padded-no-fill warns on every one (18 on Lab · Templates). Proposed: reword rule 2 per vocabulary-v6 caveat 3, and have lint skip a section whose parent is a filled Page or Card frame. Rules are owner-approved, so this waits for a yes.
